reviewer_notes.text: INTERIM SOLO REVIEW by the author of the change, pending independent re-review: the reviewer seat is out (owner decision 31 Oct 2026). I read the text of pull request 319 and the QL-1.01 spec. The criterion on removals and moves asked that a removal's citation of any kind, a reviewer note included, name the removed text contradictory or impossible. The spec's own requirement 6 already accepts a removal cited by a reviewer note whose text quotes the removed text verbatim and names where it is carried (the text is in task T1's requirements), and T1-c53 states it, so the criterion contradicted the requirement it tests. Checked by comparing the two snapshots: exactly one criterion statement of task T1 differs; its verifier is byte for byte unchanged; the new statement keeps the verbatim-quote demand for every citation kind and keeps the word contradictory or impossible for an answer, a note point and another spec's answer, and points to T1-c53 for the reviewer note path. No criterion, requirement or stop rule is removed. This aligns a statement with the requirement above it and does not weaken what the gate refuses. This is a solo review by the author and has not been independently checked.
